aop_audio_integration.architecture: Always-On Processor 2 (AOP2) to SmartIO (ASCv7) Inter-Processor Communication Fabric

shared_channels.leap: AOP_LEAP0..AOP_LEAP12 TX & RX (13 dual-direction low-latency audio stream paths)
shared_channels.mca: AOP_MCA0..AOP_MCA3 TX & RX (4 dual-direction multichannel audio bus bridges)
shared_channels.pdm: AOP_PDM0_RX (1 always-on microphone acoustic stream path)
shared_channels.audio_shim: AOP-AUDIO high-throughput shared DMA and mailbox synchronization shim
shared_channels.gp_shim: AOP-GP general purpose doorbell and event synchronization shim

operating_mechanisms.offload_pipeline: SmartIO executes all physical real-time DMA transfers, FIFO servicing, and bus clocks while the AOP2 microkernel handles high-level acoustic intelligence (Hotword detection, VAD, ANC parameter calculation).
operating_mechanisms.timestamping: Audio samples acquired across MCA and PDM are tagged with the 64-bit ARMv8 timebase counter (_RTK_DEV_TIMEBASE at 0x1c450) to maintain sub-microsecond synchronization with AOP2 audio buffers.
operating_mechanisms.power_coordination: SmartIO implements microsecond-scale hardware nap modes (_RTK_power_set_nap_mode at 0x10efc, _RTK_power_prevent_nap at 0x10ea0) that allow the coprocessor core to sleep during audio packet intervals, waking up via ASCwrap mailbox doorbells.
